notes.title: Update - FEB 03
notes.content:
Changed the balance of visas.
 Added the ability to preserve fame when getting a visa.
 City upgrade increases inspiration from moving to an upgraded city.

notes.title: Game update (achievements, better description, thematic galleries)
notes.content:
Achievements added!
 Improved the description of moving to another city.
 Added thematic galleries.
 Added new pictures.
 Added multiple vacation purchase.
 Added the ability not to go to the students tab when lecturing, as well as you can now give 10 lectures at once.
 Added (1M) button for notes.
 Enabled maximize button, also game window can now be resized.
